format: CSV saved as UTF-8 (Excel: Save As > CSV UTF-8). First row = header with the column names above, any order, any letter case (spaces or hyphens count as underscores). A few other names are read as the right column and shown in the preview panel: name/task/item -> title; project/tag -> category; due/date/deadline -> due_date; time/reminder -> remind_time; recur/recurrence/frequency -> repeat; prio -> priority; must/must_do_today -> must_today; note/details/description/comments -> notes; subtask/steps/checklist/items -> subtasks. Use the exact names to be safe. Comma separated (semicolon also read). Max 1000 tasks per file. The same text can be pasted in Settings > Import > Paste CSV (phones too).
notes: Unknown columns (e.g. Row, Other details) are ignored: the preview panel warns that their data will NOT be imported. Every import is listed in Settings > Import > Previous imports with an Undo button. If any row is invalid NOTHING is added and the page lists each line number and reason. Importing the same file twice adds every task twice.
